headreg.api.audit.no_profile: [headreg] You have no profile yet, nothing to audit.
headreg.api.clear.none: You have no registration records yet.
headreg.api.clear.done: Your registration records were cleared (numeric id kept).
headreg.api.clear.done_v2: Your registration records were cleared (numeric id kept; registering again returns the same number).
headreg.cmd.need_register: You have no registration record, run /function headreg:api/register first
headreg.cmd.need_register_bucket: No record of you in the bucket, run /function headreg:api/register first
headreg.field.name: Name:
headreg.hint.clock_derived: ← by server clock, moves with tick
headreg.value.first_register: First registration (no previous session to settle)
headreg.value.no_leave_ts: No end record (server shutdown or stats not saved); leave time unreliable, hidden
headreg.value.exit_solo: Left alone (no peer to compare, cannot tell global from personal)
headreg.value.no_prev_exit: No end record (last time was a server shutdown, or stats not saved)
headreg.help.query_others: Query others: list /trigger headreg.qlist , see one /trigger headreg.query set <number>
headreg.help.query_by_name: By name: /function headreg:api/query_name {name:你的名字} (OP required)
headreg.help.ts_meaning: Note: this is the profile fetch time (the Mojang session server regenerates it per response; a ProfileResolver.Cached hit within 10 min returns the same one), not the login time.
headreg.help.query_others_v2: Query others: /trigger headreg.qlist for the list, /trigger headreg.query set <number> for one player
headreg.help.ts_meaning_v2: Note: "profile time" is when the server fetched that profile from the session server, not the login time.
headreg.qid.history_empty: Session history none yet (settles on next join)
headreg.register.anchor_hint: ← just anchored, matching the profile time right now is normal; /function headreg:api/query later shows it advancing
headreg.register.fail: Registration failed: could not read minecraft:profile from the shared relay slot (check that chunk (1184704,1184704) is forceloaded and the relay entity exists).
headreg.register.fail_v2: Registration failed: could not read minecraft:profile from the shared relay slot (check that the relay chunk is forceloaded and the headreg.display entity exists).
headreg.register.display_timeout: Relay slot init timed out: chunk (1184704,1184704) never became ready within 200 tick, retries stopped. Check whether the chunk was removed with /forceload remove or the dimension data is broken.
headreg.register.id_exhausted: Numbers exhausted (limit 1023), not registering this time.
headreg.audit.err.out_after_leave: [audit] ✗ last segment out_sec later than last_leave_sec
headreg.audit.err.exit_kind: [audit] ✗ exit_kind has an invalid value (settled but given an invalid value)
headreg.audit.err.missing_prev_play: [audit] ✗ settled but no prev_play (and not marked as shutdown rollback)
headreg.audit.err.premium_no_leave: [audit] ✗ premium profile settled but no last_leave_sec
headreg.audit.ok.all: [audit] ✓ all 7 checks passed (per-segment checks skipped without history)
headreg.audit.err.index_mismatch: [audit] ✗ index and profile disagree (index cannot find that name or points to another id)
headreg.audit.err.dur_not_positive: [audit] ✗ last segment duration is not positive
headreg.audit.err.dur_not_positive_v2: [audit] ✗ a segment duration is not positive
headreg.exit.peers_generic: Vanished at the same moment as at least one other player (same event: server shutdown / server-wide disconnect)
headreg.exit.seen_generic: Left alone (other records on this server, none at that moment)
headreg.exit.peers: Vanished at the same moment as %s players (same event: server shutdown / server-wide disconnect)
headreg.exit.seen: Left alone (%s other records on this server, none at that moment)
headreg.tz.unknown: ⚠ preset name is not in the registry, rendered as UTC; to restore a valid name see /function headreg:api/tz_set
headreg.tz.dst_hint: (1 = DST active, 0 = standard time / not applicable to this preset)
headreg.tz.dst_on: → DST active, actual offset = base offset + 3600 s
headreg.tz.offset_pending: Actual offset: unknown until the server clock is anchored (DST likewise)
headreg.tz.now_pending: Now: server clock not anchored yet, cannot be computed; available automatically after the next registration
headreg.tz.switched_hint: ✔ switched; old records are re-rendered one by one by id (one per tick), query later for the new timezone
